u0: Starting stage: the ball is still in front of the locked door and the designated box has not been picked up. The required goal is to reach the other room and pick up that box, which requires clearing the ball, holding the matching key to unlock and open the door, and finally taking the box. The optional preferences are to clear the ball at least once and to do so before taking the key; if the key is already held, the preferred order has already been missed, the key must be put down to free a hand for the ball, and a continuing penalty applies while the key is carried before the ball is cleared. Clearing the ball advances to a later stage, while picking up the designated box completes the mission.
u1: The designated box has been picked up, so the required mission objective is satisfied and the episode ends successfully. No further action is needed. If the ball had been cleared at any point, the optional at-least-once clearing preference was met; if it was never cleared, that preference was missed. If the key was taken, the preferred order was kept only when the ball had been cleared before that key acquisition; taking the key first would have missed it.
u2: The ball has been cleared from the door at least once, so the optional at-least-once clearing preference is satisfied, and the designated box has not yet been picked up. The required objective remains to get into the other room and pick up that box, using the matching key and an open door as needed; the ball may since have been dropped back in front of the door. The preferred order is satisfied when the matching key is first acquired after the ball has been cleared; if the key had already been taken earlier and then released, that preference was missed. Putting the ball back in front of the door does not undo this stage, although it can block access again.
